Package it.polimi.ingsw.model.server

Class Player

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.server.Player
public class Player extends Object
Represents a player in a game. It saves the nickname, the color, his board and hand status during the played turn. This keeps track of the score and objectives of each player, too. All the methods that update on of the above values, also notify the change to the controller through the server subject.
